overall_notes: This paper focuses on audio deepfake detection for Portuguese speech, using zero-shot TTS models to generate synthetic speech. The main NLG task is Text-to-Speech. The paper uses automatic metrics (uTMOS, Speaker Similarity, SI-SDR, WER) to evaluate the synthetic speech quality but does not use LLMs as judges or conduct human evaluations. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization and removal of non-dataset sources.
